visitInfo.payment: Rent and deposits by bank transfer only. We never change our bank details by email; call us before paying if anything looks different.

questions.a: Ask us. Since May 2026 an owner can't unreasonably refuse a pet and must usually answer in writing within 28 days; we ask them for you and tell you why if the answer is no.
Usually two to four working days once you have sent everything. The holding deposit keeps the home for you for 15 days while we check.

questions.q: Do I get the holding deposit back?
questions.a: Yes, unless you give false information, fail a Right to Rent check, or pull out. With your agreement it goes towards your first month.

questions.q: How quickly can you let my home?
questions.a: Most homes we list are let agreed within three weeks. We tell you the rent we expect it to achieve before you sign anything.
Yes, at any renewal, at the fee shown on our fees page.

repairs.title: Report a repair
repairs.intro: Tell us what's wrong and we'll arrange the repair, usually within two working days.
repairs.emergencyIntro: Call us straight away, day or night, if:
emergencies: Water is coming through a ceiling or can't be turned off
There's no heating or hot water in winter
A smoke or carbon monoxide alarm won't stop sounding
Anything electrical is sparking or smells of burning
